d:
A fresh war of words has erupted between the Samajwadi Party and Congress ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. SP MP Iqra Hasan reminded Congress of the Samajwadi Party's contribution in securing the Leader of Opposition post in the Lok Sabha and said SP's 111 sitting seats are non-negotiable. Congress MP Imran Masood questioned the seat-sharing discussions and later responded to Iqra Hasan's remarks, saying, “She is like a child to us.”
